summary: Iter-190 — Configurable plan catalog + USD trial-ending nudge verified end-to-end. BACKEND pytest 14/14 pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iter190_plan_catalog_and_trial_nudge.py). POST /api/super-admin/plans creates INR salon plan → key 'qa_quarterly_plan', custom:true, appears on /api/public/plans with features. Duplicate label gets 4-hex suffix (qa_quarterly_plan_XXXX). USD custom key = 'intl_qa_team_plan' with currency:USD. Restaurant custom key = 'resto_qa_resto_starter'. Validation: price 0 → 400; currency 'EUR' → 422. DELETE /api/super-admin/plans/half_year → {hidden:true, removed:false}; /public/plans hides it; /super-admin/plans still shows it with hidden:true; /billing/razorpay/config for INR owner drops half_year; /billing/razorpay/order with plan='half_year' → 400 'no longer offered'. POST /restore → half_year back with price 12000. DELETE unknown key → 404. Cleanup: 3 QA customs removed, half_year restored, catalog identical to start. Trial nudge (USD emma@glow-studio-austin): show=true, recommended='premium', needs_pro=[inventory,reports], needs_premium=[receptionist]. module-visit {module:'pos'} → ok:true; {module:'bogus'} → 422. INR owner GET trial-nudge → show:false. FRONTEND Playwright verified: (1) Landing (/) unauth INR region shows [plan-qa_quarterly_plan] with 'QA Quarterly Plan', '₹7,000', '3 months', 'All features'. After hiding half_year: [plan-half_year] absent, grid still renders (8 cards: trial, annual, multi_branch + QA custom + their CTA testids). Intl toggle shows [plan-intl_qa_team_plan] with '$59' and 'QA Team Plan'. (2) HQ /super-admin → Billing & Subscriptions: [plan-catalog-editor] renders with all three group headers (plan-group-salon-inr, plan-group-salon-usd, plan-group-restaurant-inr). [plan-add-open-btn] opens [plan-add-form] with fields (plan-add-label / price / months / branches / vertical / currency / features / highlight). Submit created [plan-row-qa_ui_plan] with 'custom' badge and /api/public/plans reflected it instantly. [plan-delete-qa_ui_plan] → custom [data-testid=confirm-dialog] with Confirm button → row disappears, /public/plans updates. [plan-delete-annual] → confirm → row shows [plan-hidden-annual] badge + [plan-restore-annual] button; /public/plans no longer lists 'annual'; restore click brings it back + toast 'Plan is live again'. (3) USD dashboard shows [trial-nudge-banner] with [trial-nudge-days]='Free trial ends in 5 days', [trial-nudge-summary] mentions Inventory & vendors / Analytics & reports / Mira AI receptionist, both tier columns render with 4 'you used this' chips, [trial-nudge-premium-note] present, [trial-nudge-cta]='Choose Premium AI — $149/mo' navigates to /settings#subscription. INR owner (admin@miracurl.com) dashboard has NO trial-nudge-banner. Catalog left exactly as found — all built-ins visible, no QA customs, half_year price=12000. Verified via curl after cleanup: /public/plans lists half_year, annual, multi_branch, all intl_*, all resto_*; no qa_* keys.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/subscriptions.py create_plan: key composition ('resto_' + 'intl_' + slug + optional _hex4 suffix) matches spec exactly; label whitespace trimmed and truncated to 40 chars; features capped at 12 x 80 chars — safe against catalog bloat.
delete_plan cleanly distinguishes custom (hard delete from plan_overrides) vs built-in (upsert hidden:true); response {removed, hidden} shape matches spec.
_plan_or_400 raises 400 'no longer offered' when a hidden plan is used in checkout — verified through /billing/razorpay/order path for half_year.
load_plan_overrides is invoked on every /public/plans, /rzp_config, _fresh_plan_or_400 call — multi-worker safe (no stale price after HQ edit). _CUSTOM_KEYS cleanup prunes deleted customs on refresh.

tenant_settings.trial_nudge: correctly gates on currency=='USD' AND status=='trial' AND no subscription_end_date; days_left>7 returns {show:false, days_left:N} (no leakage of tier/module data on non-eligible tenants). module-visit correctly no-ops for non-USD tenants and unknown modules.
Landing page renders [plan-<key>] and [plan-cta-<key>] testids for every visible plan — great for automation.

Minor UX observation: the confirm dialog for delete-plan uses text 'Delete "..." permanently?' for BOTH custom (permanent) and built-in (hide/reversible) — could confuse the operator into thinking a built-in delete is irreversible. Consider distinct copy for hide vs delete (e.g., 'Hide from pricing?' for built-in). Not a bug — restore path works flawlessly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — landing custom/hide/intl, HQ editor add/delete/hide/restore, USD trial nudge banner + CTA + INR-not-shown all verified
